task.description:
rework for FAIL handoffs/M1CODE-20261119-01/step-03-security-reviewer.json and step-04-reviewer.json, review pass 1 of 3 — WF-02, CODE-FIXER, the fix round after review pass 1 of run M1CODE-20261119-01 (REQ-111, REQ-112; the change under check: git diff base/M1CODE-20261119-01-build -- app .github, then git diff base/M1CODE-20261119-01-review -- app .github for the fixes). The remarks (Critical, High and Medium must be fixed; a Low is fixed when the fix is small and safe, else not_fixed with the reason; a fix that needs a departure from the design is a stop in not_fixed):
- SEC L1 [Low] (step 03): app/scripts/public-set.js (htmlFiles; the texts module read and written; the page write) and app/scripts/vercel-build.js (fs.cpSync): the public-set writer of the open build follows symbolic links, so a write can leave its own folder. Fix: writePublicSet lstats every entry and refuses any symbolic link (a page, texts.js, a folder, examples.html) with an Error naming the file before the first write; vercel-build refuses links in the source before the copy (or copies with verbatimSymlinks).
- SEC L2 [Low] (step 03): app/server/routes/demo.js (the loadIntake shape rule; the questionnaire projection outside any try) and app/server/app.js: for an intake that loadIntake accepts but the projection cannot read (an option that is null, a field nested 20 000 deep) the questionnaire answers 500 server_error while the result answers 503 demo_unavailable. Fix: widen loadIntake, or put the questionnaire projection inside a try that maps an exception to demo_unavailable.
- REV H1 [High] (step 04) with ORCH defect O18-a and ruling decisions/0124 О19: at 320×568 the demo speaker's role title is cut in ru and kk («Руководитель проекта» 126 px in 82). О19: below 360 px the speaker block (avatar, role title, stage word) takes its own full row above the question and «‹ Назад» moves to the progress row; from 360 px the look's layout stays; the title breaks only at spaces.
- REV H2 [High] (step 04) with ORCH defect O18-b: app/public/css/site.css .skip: at 320×568 in ru the skip link wraps to two lines and its bottom 10.4 px show over the header on every page and take the taps of the header controls. Fix: the link stays out of the window by its own height, whatever its line count, until it has the focus; the focused link stays at top 8px (look 7.1).
- REV M1 [Medium] (step 04): app/public/office/draw.js names a person's hair descriptor `style` and reads look.style three times, against the closed list of .style uses of design 4.10 and decisions/0124 О5 (PP-6). Fix: rename the field (the typedef, the four people, drawPerson); nothing else changes.
- REV M2 [Medium] (step 04): one mechanism in several places (AP-014): text, wordsFor, drawnTheme, drawAvatars, syncKkNote, SYSTEM_DARK and NO_STAGE copied into both page scripts; the drawn-theme rule a third time in mountStage; the stage geometry read twice (view.js and demo.js tailX) with REDUCED_MOTION and NARROW repeated; the text of a key in a language written four ways with three fallbacks (dom.js, theme.js, labels.js, the pages). Fix: one copy each in files the design already has (no new file): drawnTheme in js/theme.js; the other helpers and the shared media queries in js/dom.js; demo.js's tail reads the same geometry helper; behaviour unchanged.
- REV L1 [Low] (step 04) with ruling decisions/0124 О20: app/public/js/pages/landing.js writes the live region of how.html at the tap; О20: it announces the new place when «Вы» stands, after the walk (at once with reduced motion).
- REV L2 [Low] (step 04): app/public/js/theme.js calls MediaQueryList addEventListener only, where view.js falls back to addListener. Fix: one listener helper for both places, together with M2.
- SEC issue I1 with ruling decisions/0124 О21: the string «ҚАЗ» stays; no change.
For each fix: a driver or a browser run that fails before and passes after; name for TEST-DESIGNER what each fix needs. Then the static part of app/ (prettier, eslint --max-warnings 0, tsc, check-public, vendored), npm run test:unit (only the 8 known reds IB-1, CP-2 at its js/ line, NPM-3, VB-1, VB-3, VB-4, CIW-1, CIW-2, each with its recorded message), npm run test:int (36 of 36), cd tools && npm run traces, then cd tools && npm run handoffs-check. Common rules: docs/workflows/handoffs.md, «Common rules for all roles» (no commit, push, tag, stash, reset or branch switch; anything that writes runs in a fresh clone of the review tag or in the scratch folder; no path of this computer in a Sai file).

result.summary: Fix round after review pass 1 of 3 (WF-02, CODE-FIXER) on the build of M1CODE-20261119-01. All eight remarks are fixed and the two ORCH defects of decisions/0124 О18 with them; О21 needed no change; nothing is left in not_fixed. 11 files of app/ changed (git diff --stat base/M1CODE-20261119-01-review -- app: 400 insertions, 404 deletions), nothing outside app/, no test file. Each fix was shown by a driver or a browser run on a fresh clone of the review tag (before) and on a second fresh clone with this diff applied (after), both under <scratch>: SEC L1 — the five link trials (a page, the texts module, a folder, examples.html, a relative link copied into another output) rewrote an outside file in 3 cases and refused none before; after, all five are refused with an Error naming the file and nothing outside changes (writePublicSet refuses every symbolic link before it reads or writes, the open build refuses a linked source before the copy). SEC L2 — an option that is null and a value nested 5 000 to 20 000 deep gave questionnaire 500 server_error against result 503; after, 503 demo_unavailable on both (the projection is inside the same mapping), every other answer the same. H1 (О18-a, by О19) — at 320 px the role title and the stage word of every demo question were cut in ru and kk (20 of 30 rows); after, below 360 px the speaker has its own full row above the question and «‹ Назад» stands on the progress row: 0 cut rows at 320 and 359 in ru, kk, en, light, dark; from 360 px the look's layout stays, where ru still cuts two titles up to 371 px (issue I1, measured, for ORCH). M1 — 13 .style member uses in the served .js files, 3 of them look.style in draw.js; after, 10, all the allowed setProperty writes, and 420 drawings (168 256 fill calls) equal call by call. M2 and L2 — every copied page helper, constant, query and the geometry reads now stand in one place (dom.js, theme.js, view.js; no new file), the theme listener falls back to addListener (before: mountTheme threw and the page scripts stopped; after: the pages run), and 252 page states of the local set (texts, names, pressed states, stage hooks, stage and avatar pixels, live region, storage) are equal before and after. What TEST-DESIGNER needs for each fix is issue I3.

issues.text: decisions/0124 О19 keeps the look's layout of the speaker from 360 px. Measured in Chrome 157 on this Mac (range.mjs, after): in that layout ru still cuts two role titles above 359 px — «Руководитель проекта» (question 1, first word 125.7 px) from 360 to 367 px, «Проверяющий» (question 5, 130 px) from 360 to 371 px; from 372 px no title or stage word is cut, kk and en none from 360. 360 px is a common phone width. The matrix windows of REQ-111 criterion 12 (1470, 390, 320) are clean, so LD-1 is not affected; outside them the cut stays as О19 rules. For ORCH: either keep О19 and name the 360-371 px cut as a limit, or move the boundary of the narrow layout to below 372 px (one value in the new block of site.css) with the look's 7.9 edit; the fixer did not change the ruled value.

What the code design and the look must follow (CODE-DESIGNER or DOC-UPDATER «As built»; GUI-DESIGN-ANALYST's next look edit, which О18 and О19 announce): (a) design 4.5 dom.js gains the exports text, wordsFor, syncKkNote, drawAvatars, onMediaChange, SYSTEM_DARK, REDUCED_MOTION, NARROW, DESKS; theme.js gains drawnTheme; view.js 4.6 gains INERT and pageGeometry (M2, by the finding's places; no new file); (b) design 4.5 «on how, the step buttons … say live_desk» and 4.6 mountStage «the live region #live» now read: the labels say live_desk when «Вы» stands, and mountStage gives #live to the labels on how.html only (О20); (c) design 4.11 writePublicSet refuses every symbolic link before step (1), and the open build refuses a linked source before the copy (step 4) (SEC L1); (d) design 4.7 the questionnaire maps a projection failure to demo_unavailable, as E8 and E12 say for both routes (SEC L2); (e) look 7.1: the skip link is off-screen at top -60px and above it by its own height (transform), focused at 8px/8px (H2); (f) look 7.9 below 360 px: the speaker's own full row above the question, «‹ Назад» on the progress row, and — measured necessary at 320 px, where the pips, the count and the button need 299 px in ru against 266 — the count under the pips when the row is too narrow (the flex row of the progress wraps; no size, colour or spacing changed). (f) is the one layout detail the fixer had to settle that О19 does not name; it goes on the owner's list of the look with the phone snapshot, as О19 says.

Tests each fix needs at step 5 (no test was written or changed here): SEC L1 — PB rows on fresh copies outside a git tree: a page that is a link to an outside page, shared/i18n/texts.js as a link, a folder link holding a page, examples.html as a link → writePublicSet rejects naming the path, the outside targets byte-equal, the copy as it was; a VB row: a relative link in the source with outDir not publicDir → exit 1 with 'vercel-build: refused: shared/i18n/texts.js: a symbolic link, which the public set does not follow', the source byte-equal, no output folder; the controls without links unchanged; mutants: refuseLinks removed, called after the import, or not called before the copy. SEC L2 — DM-6 rows: an option that is null and a value nested 20 000 deep → 503 demo_unavailable on both routes, /api/health and the pages as before; mutant: the try removed → 500. H1 — LD-1 at 320×568 reads every demo question (not only the first), and the speaker row, the h2, the progress row and «‹ Назад» do not overlap, «‹ Назад» ≥ 44×44; a check at 359 px (the new layout) and the I1 range if ORCH keeps it as a limit. H2 — LD-1: elementFromPoint at every point of the header controls returns the control in the three windows × ru, kk, en × all paths, and the focused skip link inside the window at top 8. M1 — PP-6 strict as 4.10 writes it, with no exception for draw.js. M2 — LD-4 and LD-5 now test the one drawAvatars (dom.js) and drawnTheme (theme.js); CP-3 and TC-5 still import dom.js and theme.js in Node (dom.js now imports the pure draw.js; measured loading). L1 — an e2e row on how.html: #live keeps its earlier text at the tap and says «Стол n: …» when the text list names desk n, after the walk; at once with reduced motion; on demo.html the live region never says a desk. L2 — a unit row: mountTheme with a MediaQueryList that has addListener and no addEventListener follows a system change while «Авто» (and view.js's reduced-motion listener the same through onMediaChange). No existing test checks a behaviour this step changed: the 8 known reds have the same messages, int 36 of 36.

SEC L1, the kind of error (role step 3): a hard link is another way a write can leave its folder; it is not refused. A git checkout and the Vercel upload give separate files, and a build machine that materialised two equal files as one inode would make a refusal of nlink > 1 fail a legitimate build. Only symbolic links are refused, as the finding says. check-public (step 3 of the build and of npm run check) still reads and imports through a link (no write), as the finding's alternative left it; ORCH may ask for a link rule there by a design edit.

Behaviour of the one text rule (M2) on inputs that cannot occur today: before, applyTexts left an element alone and the theme button wrote "" when an entry lacked the page's language; now both write the Russian value of the entry (the rule of the pages and the labels). Every entry of the local and of the public texts module holds every language of its LANGS (TX-2; renderTexts throws otherwise), and the page's language is always one of LANGS, so no page shows a difference (252 states equal).
